detailZones.title: Reclaim carousel
detailZones.description: Follow the complete reclaim carousel, belt hardware, chute and transfer surfaces.

detailZones.title: Luggage detail
detailZones.description: Inspect distinct cases and bags on the carousel, including handles, wheels, tags and fasteners.

detailZones.title: Arrival facilities
detailZones.description: Explore the arrivals foyer, service desk, doors, carts, seating, lighting and public fixtures.

detailZones.title: Customs and inspection
detailZones.description: Inspect the customs booths, counters, dividers, queue rails and the service-side baggage equipment.

detailZones.title: Reception and architecture
detailZones.description: Study the reception counter, monitor, wood panels, planter and public-room surface details.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source and resized baggage-claim photographs were inspected at native and final pixels. This batch retains 95 independently pointable carousel, luggage, arrivals, customs, service and reception objects or parts across five bounded exploration zones. Passenger identities, flight numbers, customs outcomes, airline brands, written screen content and inferred baggage-processing states were excluded.
